title: helm(private): stabilize values templating and init jobs for upgrade/rollback
author: Evelyn Park
release_notes:
- Fix: templated initJob values for Postgres restore to preserve nodeAffinity and tolerations across upgrades
- Improvement: add helm hooks (pre-upgrade/post-rollback) to safely manage init jobs and backups
- Docs: document values.schema.json for init job templating and add troubleshooting notes for upgrade failures
description:
Motivation: customers running Redwood Private in air-gapped or heterogenous k8s clusters experienced failed upgrades when initJobs (postgres restore, kms key sync) were re-created without preserving nodeAffinity/tolerations or when templated values were omitted during a rollback. This PR stabilizes Helm templating for init jobs and introduces lifecycle hooks to make upgrades and rollbacks safe.

What this change does: - Add explicit values.schema.json entries for initJob sections so values.yaml validation fails fast for missing fields. - Update templates/private/init-job.yaml to merge nodeAffinity/tolerations from top-level values and subchart overrides; preserve any user overrides. - Introduce templates/private/hooks/backup-and-restore-hooks.yaml with pre-upgrade and post-rollback hooks that mark initJobs as safe-to-run and orchestrate Postgres backup/restore where applicable. - Add helper tpl functions in _helpers.tpl for canonicalizing podSpec fields used by initJobs. - Add helm unit tests and a small integration test that runs a simulated upgrade/rollback cycle in KinD (CI).

Checklist: - [x] values.schema.json entries added and documented - [x] Templates updated to use helper functions for stable merging - [x] Hooks implemented with appropriate ttl and failurePolicy - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration test added and green in CI

Notes: migration is opt-in for clusters that provide custom nodeAffinity/tolerations; default behavior preserves existing semantics. See README section "Upgrade/rollback behavior for initJobs" for operator guide. Linked Linear tasks: ENG-2148 (initJob templating spec), ENG-2175 (rollback hooks and tests).

merge_commit_message:
helm(private): stabilize values templating and init jobs for upgrade/rollback

Adds schema validation, helper templates, hooks for safe backups, unit and integration tests. See ENG-2148, ENG-2175.
upgrade_notes: When upgrading: if you have custom nodeAffinity/tolerations for init jobs, set values.initJob.nodeAffinity and values.initJob.tolerations explicitly prior to upgrade to preserve scheduling. The hooks will run a pre-upgrade backup for Postgres clusters that enable backups=true. If you need to opt-out, set hooks.enabled=false.
